# Forbes & Partners

> > Forbes & Partners is a luxury real estate agency specializing in high-end villa sales, rentals, and property investment services across Koh Samui, Phuket, and Thailand.

The firm provides comprehensive services for high-net-worth individuals seeking luxury properties in Thailand, including villa rentals, property sales, investment guidance, tax planning for foreign investors, and curated lifestyle experiences. Forbes & Partners focuses on premium locations like Koh Samui, Phuket, Chaweng, Bang Por, and Kamala, offering both vacation rentals and long-term property investment opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Luxury villa rentals and sales
- Koh Samui and Phuket real estate
- Thai rental income tax (PND.94, PND.90)
- Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa
- Thailand property investment for foreigners
- Sea view properties and land plots
- In-villa spa services
- Tax residency and double taxation treaties
- HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) services
- Villa classification standards
- Land and Building Tax
- Thai hospitality and wellness
- Property income tax compliance
- Infinity pool villas
- Thailand lifestyle experiences
